image_policy: Original encoded bytes copied without resizing, cropping, recompression, retouching or metadata rewriting. Pillow used only to decode/validate images and read format/dimensions.
acceptance_policy: Historical failed images are retained. No filename or build group implies final acceptance. Use the report matrix and last applicable independent review update.
build_group_identity_note: Build-group mapping is the root operator report. Final installed executable hashes are maintained separately by the root task; this manifest does not equate every screenshot with that executable.

normal.basis: prepare.py configuration and root operator report

narrow.basis: prepare.py configuration and root operator report

wide.basis: prepare.py configuration and root operator report; check03-34 explicitly exercises 150%

empty.basis: prepare_empty.py; isolated empty configuration, not normal fixture theme

capture_profiles.overrides: Palette captures switch the named palette. check08-08/09 switch the normal release fixture to dark appearance. check10-01/02/03 are release normal 1140x820 at 200%; the validation-window override is debug-only, so check10-04 to 51 uses debug e217d0d for exact 860x620; check12-01 to 05 uses debug 5740837, followed by release 9ec2f6e in check12-06 onward. Original rejected/before images do not inherit fixture profiles solely from matching pixel dimensions.

check03.role: intermediate; individual unchanged states can be referenced, not a final pass

final.role: historical failed restored-input layout; final in filename is not final acceptance

palette.role: ten actual palette selections; scoped appearance evidence

check04.role: intermediate and targeted rechecks; later geometry fixes are not present

check06.role: mixed states, including failures corrected in check08

check08.role: release performance capture set; per-frame status and later fixes must be read in report

check09.role: 01-08 retain intermediate findings; later e217 rechecks are check11, not a retroactive upgrade of these images

check10.build_mode: 01-03 release normal window at 6c2e997; 04-51 debug exact narrow window at e217d0d
check10.role: 01-03 are normal 1140x820 at 200%; 04-51 uses e217d0d source in debug to set exact 860x620 at 200%; individual frames require independent review

check11.role: normal/fault rechecks; 06 is a newly discovered stale-notice failure, 07 is already ready, not preparation loading

check12.build_mode: 01-05 debug 5740837 exact narrow at 200%; 06 onward release 9ec2f6e without performance
check12.role: targeted final switch, restored-reader and partial-result rechecks; scope comes from independent image review

installed.role: actual installed Design Preview About, user library and reader; installation.json supplies identity, independent review supplies pictured composition

debug-selector.role: excluded file-picker diagnostic crop; not page review evidence
